title: Renovate the Interior of B1832
agency_path: DEPT OF DEFENSE.DEPT OF THE AIR FORCE.AIR COMBAT COMMAND.FA4803  20 CONS LGCA
detail_text: 1. Description: This is a Sources Sought Notice and is issued solely for market research and planning purposes to identify potential sources capable of providing the construction needs for the Renovate the interior of B1832 in accordance with the Statement of Work. This requirement is for a construction contract for the renovation of B1832. Contractor shall be responsible for providing all materials and labor for the identified work. Work shall occur in areas within B1832 as identified within this SOW and on the attached drawings.2. Submission Requirements Interested vendors are invited to submit the following information:? Company Information? Company name, address, and point of contact (name, email, phone)? CAGE code and UEI (if available)? Applicable NAICS codesCapabilities Statement? Description of your ability to fulfill the listed requirements in the statement of work? Expected Magnitude? Indicate your ability to perform at Shaw AFB3. Submission InstructionsResponse Deadline: 13 March 2026, 2:00 PM ESTSubmission Method: Email responses to both johnathan.youngblood.2@us.af.mil and braulio.ramirez_galvan@us.af.milSubject Line: Sources Sought Response- Renovate the Interior of B1832This Sources Sought is issued solely for information and planning purposes and does not constitute a solicitation.This notice shall not be construed as a commitment by the Government to issue a solicitation or award a contract. The Government will not reimburse any costs incurred in responding to this notice. All information submitted in response to this announcement is voluntary.
